steps.action: drop in sky with blue and black

steps.subject: water
steps.action: water at the bottom of the sky

steps.subject: sky
steps.action: blend the sky gently with a clean brush

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: dab in little floater clouds with titanium white

steps.subject: cloud
steps.action: blend the base of the cloud, lift lightly along the angles
steps.where: base of the cloud, not the top

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: lay in the mountain mass with the knife
steps.load: pulled out flat, roll on the knife edge
steps.motion: push firmly and scrape off the excess
steps.where: peak high in the sky with a bump beside it
steps.rule: pushing firmly works the paint into the canvas texture

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: pull the base down with the large brush
steps.motion: pull down and blend, paint moves on the liquid white
steps.rule: the liquid white lets paint move, which a dry canvas would not

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: touch the snow break on the mountain with the small knife
steps.motion: touch and let it bounce, no pulling
steps.rule: touching breaks the paint so it is not too even and smooth

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: touch more ridges and valleys with knife to wrap the light
steps.motion: touch and let it bounce, wrap around
steps.rule: the light still strikes from one direction, so follow the angles

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: touch shadows with phthalo blue and white roll
steps.load: mixed blue and white, cut across, roll
steps.motion: barely touch and let the canvas pull off paint

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: shadow under the highlight with a little more white
steps.load: a little more white in the mix
steps.motion: bring it down, let it come together
steps.where: below the highlight, down the mountain

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap the base for a little mist

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: another mountain in front with dark mix pushed in
steps.motion: push right down with firm pressure
steps.where: in front of the first mountain

steps.subject: mountain
steps.action: bounce shadow touches on the front mountain with the small knife
steps.where: shadow spots where light would play through

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: dirty green fan brush for evergreens by touching and pulling down
steps.load: dirty green mix, loaded on both sides
steps.rule: a quick way to show many small trees

steps.subject: mist
steps.action: tap firmly at the base of the trees for mist
steps.rule: the misty area separates the layers, so keep it

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: closer darker evergreens touched in with the fan
steps.rule: closer things are darker so they stand out

steps.subject: evergreen
steps.action: big fat evergreen tree with fan corner, back and forth
steps.load: both sides of the brush loaded
steps.motion: back and forth, pushing harder going down
steps.where: one tree in front of the mountain

steps.action: brown tree trunk with the knife

steps.subject: leaf tree

steps.subject: grass
steps.action: tap grassy areas with the dark mix, pick up color off the tree
steps.motion: tap and let it work down

steps.subject: reflection
